options.help_text: Select a data type, submit, then choose its schedule. Apply returns to this screen. Select Save all changes and finish to save. Shared schedule follows the hub; custom schedules are independent.

options.apply: Apply to draft and return to overview

options.title: Refresh schedules
options.help: Select General to edit the default. Choose a data type to set its own schedule, or keep Use General checked. Switch between types freely; Submit saves all changes together.
options.yaml: YAML overrides the General schedule. Custom data schedules remain independent.
options.changed: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving; your draft is still here.
options.invalid: Check time, interval (5–1440 minutes) and weekly days for every edited type.
options.error: Could not load or save schedules.
options.empty_warning: An empty selection creates no school-data sensors.
options.choose_school_id: Enter the school ID or a name ending in (school ID).
options.account_schedules: Shared account / school data and defaults
options.student_help: These schedules apply only to the selected student. General sets this student’s default; each data type can use its own schedule.
options.account_help: Holidays belong to the school and Mailbox to the account. Other schedules here are inherited defaults for students without overrides.
options.registration_students: Registration saves initial defaults. After authentication, choose each student here to set their own schedules.

refresh_now.name: Refresh data

set_options.description: Update hub options. Specify entry_id when multiple hubs exist.

mailbox_full_content.name: Full message content (marks conversations read)
mailbox_full_content.description: Full message content is off by default. Enabling it marks fetched conversations as read in Mashov, even if you have not opened them yourself.

mailbox_limit.description: Up to 50 recent inbox conversations. Older conversations and attachment files are not fetched.

create_live_dashboard.name: Create Mashov Live dashboard
create_live_dashboard.description: Build the Mashov Live Bubble Card dashboard into an existing UI dashboard.

family.name: Family (sees every card)
family.description: People who see every card. Required for children who have no linked person.

students.name: Students
students.description: Optional tweaks per child (emoji, color, linked person, viewers). Omit to include every child.

overwrite.name: Replace existing content
overwrite.description: Replace a dashboard that already has other content, or a built-in dashboard such as the Overview. The previous content is lost.
